survey.description: Warehouse pickers treated as self-employed, deductions from pay

evidence.summary: 'Independent contractor agreement' between Riverside Book Distribution and the worker: no guaranteed hours, worker must use company scanner and wear company uniform, shifts allocated by the company app, £45 weekly 'equipment fee'.

conversation: I pick orders in the Riverside warehouse that ships books for publishers. They say we are self-employed contractors, but we work fixed shifts set by them, wear their uniform and use their scanners.
Thank you. How are you paid?
Per order picked. They take a £45 equipment fee every week for the scanner and uniform. If we are late they deduct a full hour. Some weeks after deductions I earn less than the minimum wage.
Do you get holiday pay or sick pay?
No holiday pay and no sick pay. When I was ill for a week in March I lost the whole week and still paid the equipment fee.
Have you or colleagues raised this?
A group of us asked for a meeting in May. After that the app gave us fewer shifts. My shifts went from five a week to two.
